# Physiology, Placenta

**Authors:** Vaishali Kapila, Khalid Chaudhry

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The placenta is the medium through which material passes from the maternal circulation to the fetal circulation by passive diffusion or active transport.
